# bot-logins.txt: GitHub logins of the officer GitHub Apps that may open PRs here.
#
# A PR whose AUTHOR is listed here is checked by .github/workflows/officer-pr-check.yml
# whatever its head branch is named. A head branch starting with `officer/` is checked too,
# whoever opened it. The branch name alone is not an identity (the prefix is configurable on
# the agent side), so both select.
#
# Read from the BASE commit only, so a PR cannot add or remove a login to decide whether it
# is checked. The file is also forbidden to officer PRs (.github, forbidden-paths.txt).
#
# Format: one login per line, `<app-slug>[bot]`, compared case-insensitively. `#` starts a
# comment; blank lines are ignored.
#
# PLACEHOLDER: the release-followup officer's GitHub App does not exist yet. Once it is
# created, replace the next comment line with its bot login, uncommented:
# civitai-officer-release-followup[bot]
#
# PLACEHOLDER: the ci-watch officer's GitHub App does not exist yet either. Once it is
# created, replace the next comment line with its bot login, uncommented:
# civitai-officer-ci-watch[bot]
